name: make doc staleness explicit and right-size the notebook and test guardrails
objective: Implement the operator's three resolved decisions from P21's deferred questions. (1) D14 -- no fixed docs-phase cadence: consolidation runs only when the operator wants it; in exchange every durable doc carries an explicit last-updated marker (source commit, date, consolidating phase -- in docs/index.json and surfaced where agents read docs), plus doctrine that a doc older than the owed Doc-impact notes is stale evidence, not truth. (2) D15 -- relax the phase-notebook budget to a soft ~100k-token cap (warning-only), replacing the 16 KB / 200-line squeeze that forced four P21 slices to compress; keep the finish-slice size printout. (3) D16 -- sharpen keep-tests-small: test files only for very core behavior, never style/cosmetic/trivial surface -- verified live instead. Machinery and doctrine in this repo only (adopters inherit via upgrade); close D14/D15/D16 when the phase passes.

acceptance.note: machinery and doctrine only; no operator-visible running product
